thesis: The episode explores Michael Schwimmer's transition from a professional baseball player to the CEO of Big League Advance, a firm that invests in minor league players for a share of their future earnings. Schwimmer argues that his success relies on applying statistical analysis and 'moneyball' strategies to improve the fortunes of minor leaguers, a group where he notes that less than 10% of the 7,000 players advance to the majors.
